data.title: About Christina
bio: Working out of Green Light Realty's Central Jersey office, Christina supports clients in Middlesex, Monmouth, and Ocean County.
Behind every Green Light Realty transaction is a team keeping things moving, and Christina is part of how the brokerage stays organized, responsive, and easy to work with.
Reach out to Christina for local market expertise and guidance from first conversation to closing day.
